messages.subject: FW: Re: Activation Rqst - Dealer Addendums - Inventory Feed Request for: Cedar Bend Motors?? and Cedar Bend Ford    [ ref:!00Df20Cce8.!500iL0FixT01:ref ]
messages.bodyHtml:
Wade,

Hello. Unfortunately, the Data Authorization form indicate that you allow Autosoft to share "GoBatch" data with Dealer Addendums. Your dealership is not a "GO" Dealer so "GoBatch" data is not the appropriate data feed selection. Please submit a form from each dealership with the proper integration indicated.

Dealer Addendums typically requests the "ASIS_VehInv2" which pulls data from the dealers Accounting Platform. Please indicate on the form the data feed that you would like to shared with Dealer Addendums and resubmit to us.

We thank you for your understanding.


Thank you,
Terri Moss
